parameters.name: separating/clique/freq
parameters.description: frequency for calling separator clique (-1: never, 0: only in root node)

parameters.name: misc/usesymmetry
parameters.description: bitset describing used symmetry handling technique (0: off; 1: constraint-based orbitopes/symresacks + lexicographic/orbital reduction; 2: orbital reduction; 3: orbitopes+symresacks+lexicographic/orbital; 4: Schreier Sims cuts; 5: Schreier Sims+orbitopes+symresacks+lexicographic; 6: Schreier Sims+orbital; 7: Schreier Sims+orbitopes+symresacks+lexicographic/orbital)

parameters.name: lp/pricing
parameters.description: LP pricing strategy

parameters.name: lp/refactorinterval
parameters.description: LP refactorization interval (0: auto)

parameters.name: lp/scaling
parameters.description: LP scaling (0: none, 1: normal, 2: aggressive)

parameters.name: presolving/maxrounds
parameters.description: maximal number of presolving rounds (-1: unlimited, 0: off)

parameters.name: presolving/donotaggr
parameters.description: should aggregation be disabled (alternative to probing presolver)

parameters.name: presolving/donotmultaggr
parameters.description: should multi-aggregation be disabled

parameters.name: separating/oddcycle/freq
parameters.description: frequency for calling separator oddcycle (-1: never, 0: only in root node)

parameters.name: propagating/maxrounds
parameters.description: maximal number of propagation rounds per node (-1: unlimited)

parameters.name: propagating/maxroundsroot
parameters.description: maximal number of propagation rounds in the root node (-1: unlimited)

parameters.name: separating/maxroundsroot
parameters.description: maximal number of separation rounds in the root node (-1: unlimited)

parameters.name: separating/maxstallrounds
parameters.description: maximal number of consecutive separation rounds without improvement

parameters.name: separating/gomory/freq
parameters.description: frequency for calling separator gomory (-1: never, 0: only in root)

parameters.name: separating/zerohalf/maxrounds
parameters.description: maximal number of zerohalf separation rounds per node (-1: unlimited)

parameters.name: separating/disjunctive/maxroundsroot
parameters.description: maximal number of disjunctive separation rounds in root (-1: no limit)

parameters.name: cutselection/hybrid/minortho
parameters.description: minimal orthogonality for a cut to enter the LP

parameters.name: cutselection/ensemble/maxnonzerorootround
parameters.description: max non-zeros per round applied cuts in root (multiple of num LP cols)

parameters.name: heuristics/feaspump/freq
parameters.description: frequency for calling primal heuristic feaspump (-1: never)

parameters.name: heuristics/alns/freq
parameters.description: frequency for calling primal heuristic alns (-1: never)

parameters.name: heuristics/undercover/freq
parameters.description: frequency for calling primal heuristic undercover (-1: never)

parameters.name: heuristics/dins/minfixingrate
parameters.description: minimum percentage of integer variables that have to be fixable

parameters.name: heuristics/lpface/minfixingrate
parameters.description: required percentage of fixed integer variables in sub-MIP to run

parameters.name: heuristics/subnlp/presolveemphasis
parameters.description: presolve emphasis in sub-SCIP (0: default, 1: aggressive, 2: fast, 3: off)

parameters.name: branching/preferbinary
parameters.description: should branching on binary variables be preferred

parameters.name: branching/fullstrong/maxdepth
parameters.description: maximal depth level for fullstrong branching (-1: no limit)

parameters.name: branching/relpscost/sbiterquot
parameters.description: maximal fraction of strong branching LP iterations compared to node LP iterations

parameters.name: branching/relpscost/degeneracyaware
parameters.description: should degeneracy be taken into account (0: off, 1: after root, 2: always)

parameters.name: conflict/enable
parameters.description: should conflict analysis be enabled

parameters.name: conflict/useinflp
parameters.description: should infeasible LP conflict analysis be used (o: off, c: conflict graph, d: dual ray, b: both)
